build_batched_dot_product: build a batched dot product function using vmap over torch.dot with two batched tensors
build_batched_linear_model: build a batched linear model by vmap over a single example function with batched inputs
build_batched_jacobian: build a vectorized Jacobian computation using vmap over autograd.grad with an identity matrix
build_chunked_vmap: build a chunked vmap function that processes input data in chunks to reduce memory usage
review_vmap_in_dims: review the vmap in_dims parameter to specify which input dimension to map over
